title: Correct the stale compaction-deferral comment on persist_test_run_evidence_batch_deferring_compaction_locked
outcome: Correct the stale compaction-deferral comment on persist_test_run_evidence_batch_deferring_compaction_locked
acceptance: The doc comment on persist_test_run_evidence_batch_deferring_compaction_locked (src/test_run_observations.rs, about line 729) states that the idle compaction step selects because the batch clears compaction_examined_revision (the else-branch at about line 858), not because the batch commits a new revision.
